=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:489-496 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `gh issue create` fails, the script exits early after posting an error comment and skips the dependency-comment loop and final summary comment.
  WHY: This leaves the source issue partially updated and omits the blocker/dependency metadata the orchestrator uses to track created fix-up issues.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:136-170 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `git diff HEAD` is written into the diagnose prompt without any size limit.
  WHY: Large diffs can blow up prompt/context size or slow the diagnose step, and multiple reviewers flagged it as a robustness risk.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:170,294 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git diff HEAD` output is included in the prompt without size limiting.
  WHY: Large diffs could exceed the LLM context window or cause Codex to fail or truncate output.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:63-67 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES` only accepts `1|true|yes|on`, so other truthy strings fall through to false.
  WHY: Existing configurations that use non-standard truthy values would unexpectedly hit `harness_error`.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:89,498 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script outputs `handled=true` early but can still exit with error 1 if fix-up issue creation fails.
  WHY: This creates contradictory signals for the calling workflow about whether the post-diagnosis handling succeeded.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:365 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: If `gh issue create` fails in the fix-up loop, the script terminates before the source issue is fully labeled and summarized.
  WHY: The failure path stops the process before the issue is correctly marked `ai:implementation-failed` and before the user gets a complete summary comment.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:136 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Building the diff with `git diff HEAD` has no size guard.
  WHY: Large worktrees can produce oversized prompts that may exceed token limits or local temp storage during `codex exec`.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:270 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: JSON extraction depends on `python3` being available.
  WHY: The script has no shell fallback for extraction, making `python3` a single point of failure even if GitHub Actions usually provides it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

  PROBLEM: When creation of one or more fix-up issues fails, the script exits immediately after posting an error comment and skips the dependency-comment loop and final summary comment.
  WHY: The source issue is left partially updated and the blocker/dependency metadata never gets written.
